name: build-visionos-apps
description: Build, run, debug, refactor, and ship visionOS 27 apps with XcodeBuildMCP-first Apple Vision Pro workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, debug, refactor, and ship visionOS 27 apps with XcodeBuildMCP-first workflows
interface.longDescription: Development for Apple Vision Pro on visionOS 27: spatial SwiftUI, ARKit, SharePlay, WidgetKit, immersive media, app architecture, signing, packaging, telemetry, SwiftPM, simulator UI automation, Spatial Preview, XcodeBuildMCP-first build/run/debug workflows, command entrypoints, and Run-button fallback bootstrap. Link to Build with RealityKit for RealityKit runtime work and Build with Reality Composer Pro 3 for authored graph, package, and USD asset-pipeline work.
defaultPrompt: Build, run, and debug a visionOS 27 app with XcodeBuildMCP on Apple Vision Pro Simulator.
Choose the right window, volume, immersive surface, ARKit provider, SharePlay flow, or WidgetKit surface.
Route RealityKit runtime work to Build with RealityKit and authored RCP3 graph/package work to Build with Reality Composer Pro 3.
